## Details

<a id="install_interrupts"></a>
### [`install_interrupts`](../../../../src/irq/interrupts.asm#L6) `$8076`

*routine*

Sets the IRQ vector $0314 to irq_handler and the NMI vector $0318 to nmi_handler. Clears the message timer $2f. Starts the raster interrupt at line 0. Stops the tune ($1a = 0), sets the tune tempo $10/$11 to 3 and the SID volume to 15. Then copies the status texts (JSR $8995).
X is not used

- **Called from:** [`$8205`](../../../../src/init/game_init.asm#L9)

- **Reads:** [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY)
- **Writes:** [`CINV`](../../memory-map.md#CINV), [`NMINV`](../../memory-map.md#NMINV), [`message_timer`](../../memory-map.md#message_timer), [`IRQMSK`](../../memory-map.md#IRQMSK), [`RASTER`](../../memory-map.md#RASTER), [`VCREG3`](../../memory-map.md#VCREG3), [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`music_playing`](../../memory-map.md#music_playing), [`music_tick`](../../memory-map.md#music_tick), [`music_speed`](../../memory-map.md#music_speed), [`SIGVOL`](../../memory-map.md#SIGVOL)

<a id="irq_handler"></a>
### [`irq_handler`](../../../../src/irq/interrupts.asm#L44) `$80C0`

*routine*

IRQ handler. An interrupt that is not the raster interrupt goes to the KERNAL at $ea31. On the raster interrupt (line 0, each frame), when the tune flag $1a is not 0, it counts down the tempo counter $10. When it gets to 0, it reloads it from $11 and does one tune step: the message timer and the two voices of the tune. Then it goes to the KERNAL at $ea31.

- **Jumps to:** `$EA31`
- **Reads:** [`VICIRQ`](../../memory-map.md#VICIRQ), [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`music_playing`](../../memory-map.md#music_playing), [`music_tick`](../../memory-map.md#music_tick), [`music_speed`](../../memory-map.md#music_speed), [`message_timer`](../../memory-map.md#message_timer), [`voice1_duration`](../../memory-map.md#voice1_duration), [`voice1_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#voice1_ptr), [`voice1_ptr_hi`](../../memory-map.md#voice1_ptr_hi), [`note_freq_lo`](../music/note_frequencies.md#note_freq_lo), [`note_freq_hi`](../music/note_frequencies_81c2.md#note_freq_hi), [`music_off`](../../memory-map.md#music_off) and 3 more
